solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Mediterranean islander in prison with army officer

parts.note: a major is a commissioned army officer
can is slang for prison

explanation.surface: A man from a Mediterranean island is locked up alongside a military officer.
explanation.walkthrough: The prison comes first in the clue but last in the answer; 'with' simply joins the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A Majorcan is a native of Majorca, the largest of the Balearic Islands in the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Fellow diner putting hot water on tea

parts.note: to be in hot water is to be in a mess
maté is a South American tea

explanation.surface: A dining companion pours hot water onto tea.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' puts MESS above MATE.
explanation.definitionFit: A messmate is someone you eat with in a mess, as on a ship.

clue.text: Judge takes female relative for pleasure trip

parts.note: an aunt is a female relative

explanation.surface: A judge takes an aunt on an outing.
explanation.definitionFit: A jaunt is a short excursion for enjoyment.

clue.text: Strange upset after gang followed the French primate

indicators.note: after puts the reversed piece at the end, following the rest

parts.note: a ring is a gang, as in a drugs ring
tailed means followed
le is French for the

indicators.note: upset in a down clue turns the word upside down, reading it backwards

parts.note: rum is British slang for strange

explanation.surface: Something strange is upset after a gang followed the French.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns RUM to MUR; RUM meaning odd is British slang.
explanation.definitionFit: The ring-tailed lemur is a Madagascan primate with a striped tail.

clue.text: Son dividing silver isn't commonly in opposition

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

indicators.note: dividing means splitting the other pieces by sitting inside them

parts.note: ain't is a common or colloquial form of isn't

explanation.surface: A son splitting the family silver isn't popular with the rest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dividing' puts S into AGAINT between N and T.
explanation.definitionFit: Against means opposed to, so it works as in opposition.

clue.text: Burn most of music at church

indicators.note: most of a word means it loses its final letter here

parts.note: a score is written music

explanation.surface: Someone burns most of the sheet music at a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' trims SCORE to SCOR.
explanation.definitionFit: To scorch is to burn a surface lightly, so the two verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Diplomat's accusation over plants choking river

definitions.note: read as diplomat is, the 's being a link

indicators.note: in a down clue over puts the first piece above the second

parts.note: a charge is an accusation

indicators.note: choking means surrounding and squeezing the river inside

parts.note: daffs is short for daffodils
the Aire is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: A diplomat faces an accusation of letting plants choke a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'choking' puts the river inside the plants. 'over' only stacks the pieces because this is a down clue. The Aire is a river in Yorkshire, northern England.
explanation.definitionFit: A chargé d'affaires is a diplomat who stands in for an ambassador.

clue.text: Process of tailoring brightly coloured suit

parts.note: red is a bright colour
an action is a lawsuit

explanation.surface: Tailoring a bright red suit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tailoring' here means adapting text, not making clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Redaction is editing a text to fit a purpose, so a process of tailoring it.

clue.text: Way in which poor Amy enters farm store

indicators.note: enters means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: how is a way of doing something

indicators.note: poor signals the name Amy is badly put together, rearranged

explanation.surface: A route along which poor Amy walks into a farm storehouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'poor' rearranges the name to AYM, and 'enters' sends it inside; 'Way' is a manner, not a road.
explanation.definitionFit: A haymow is a stack of hay or the loft where hay is stored on a farm.

clue.text: Blue dog in US space station

parts.note: sky blue; the sky is blue
a lab is a Labrador dog

explanation.surface: A sad dog aboard an American space station.
explanation.definitionFit: Skylab was NASA's first space station, launched in 1973.

clue.text: Reject third of yarn twisted on the outside

indicators.note: the word for twisted sits on the outside, wrapping round the picked letter

parts.note: yarn is spun, i.e. twisted into thread

indicators.note: third of picks the third letter of the word yarn

explanation.surface: A knitter rejects a third of some yarn because it is twisted on the outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'third of' picks R from yarn, and 'on the outside' puts SPUN round it.
explanation.definitionFit: To spurn is to reject with contempt, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Clumsily misused walkway crossing road

indicators.note: the rearranged letters cross, i.e. span, the abbreviation for road set inside them
misused signals the letters of walkway are put to wrong use, rearranged

explanation.surface: A walkway used wrongly, cutting clumsily across a road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'misused' rearranges the walkway into AWKWALY, and 'crossing' sets the road abbreviation inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Awkwardly describes doing something without grace or skill, which is what clumsily means.

clue.text: Dull time touring university in Alabama in the morning

indicators.note: touring means going round, so the first pieces travel around the university letter

parts.note: mat (or matt) describes a dull, non-glossy finish
AL is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Alabama

explanation.surface: A dull spell touring a university in Alabama in the morning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'touring' puts MAT and T round U to make MATUT; 'in' is taken as written. The blog reads MATT as the dull word, but then 'time' would have no job.
explanation.definitionFit: Matutinal is a formal adjective for things happening early in the day, from Latin matutinus.

clue.text: Lizard finally feeling all right about crossing City area

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word feeling

parts.note: EC is the postcode area for the City of London

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the letters for all right are read backwards

parts.note: OK means all right

explanation.surface: Someone finally feeling all right about crossing a part of the City.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns OK into KO; 'crossing' just joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A gecko is a small climbing lizard, so the answer is an example of the definition.

clue.text: Person travelling to ancient city is German

parts.note: Ur was an ancient city of Mesopotamia, a crossword favourite
ist is the German word for is

explanation.surface: A person heading to an ancient city happens to be German.
explanation.walkthrough: IST is simply 'is' translated into German.
explanation.definitionFit: A tourist is someone who travels for pleasure, so a person travelling describes one.

clue.text: Experienced people keeping peace on river

parts.note: the UN, United Nations, is a peacekeeping body
the Derwent is a river in England

explanation.surface: People keeping the peace by a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' sets UN above DERWENT in the down clue; the Derwent is one of several English rivers of that name.
explanation.definitionFit: Underwent means went through or experienced, the past tense matching.

clue.text: Little bird soldier kept in Cornish resort

indicators.note: kept in means one piece is held inside the other

parts.note: Bude is a seaside resort in Cornwall
GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A small bird and a soldier are stuck in a Cornish seaside town.
explanation.walkthrough: BUDE is a seaside town in Cornwall, the county at England's south-western tip.
explanation.definitionFit: A budgie, short for budgerigar, is a small parrot kept as a pet, so it is a little bird.

clue.text: Tacky bloke reportedly on addictive drug

indicators.note: reportedly means the word is as heard, not as spelt

parts.note: Jim is a man's name, standing for any bloke
crack is a form of cocaine

explanation.surface: A tacky man reportedly on an addictive drug.
explanation.definitionFit: Gimcrack describes showy but cheap and flimsy goods, the same as tacky.

clue.text: Appearance of commercial opening

parts.note: an ad is a commercial
a vent is an opening

explanation.surface: The appearance of an advertisement at a launch.
explanation.definitionFit: An advent is an arrival or coming into view, so it means appearance.

clue.text: Neptune's satellite's interval discharging energy

indicators.note: discharging means letting go of a letter, removing it

parts.note: a tritone is a musical interval of three whole tones
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Neptune's moon is a gap from which energy discharges.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after satellite is 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Triton is the largest moon of Neptune.

clue.text: Holding key, somehow define old Turkish title

indicators.note: holding means the rearranged letters contain the key letter
somehow signals the letters of define are arranged in some other way

parts.note: F is a musical key

explanation.surface: Holding a key, someone tries to define an old Turkish honorific.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram indicator rearranges DEFINE to EFENDI, and 'Holding' takes F, a musical key, inside it after the first F.
explanation.definitionFit: Effendi was a courtesy title in the Ottoman Empire for officials and educated men, akin to sir.

clue.text: Old German prince dropping round with a complex woman?

indicators.note: dropping means letting a letter fall away

parts.note: an elector was a prince entitled to elect the Holy Roman Emperor
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: An old German prince drops round with a complicated woman.
explanation.walkthrough: The Electra complex is a Freudian idea; the question mark flags the pun.
explanation.definitionFit: Electra gives her name to the Electra complex, so she is the woman behind that psychological term.

clue.text: Golfing assistants ignoring European's coarse yarn

indicators.note: ignoring means leaving a letter out

parts.note: caddies carry a golfer's clubs
E is the abbreviation for European

explanation.surface: Golf caddies ignoring a European's rough wool.
explanation.definitionFit: Caddis is a worsted yarn or tape used in braiding, a coarse thread.

clue.text: Worry about electoral system for thirty days

indicators.note: about means placed around, so the word for worry surrounds the other piece

parts.note: to ail is to trouble or worry
PR stands for proportional representation, an electoral system

explanation.surface: Fretting over an electoral system for a month.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' wraps the worry round the voting system; 'thirty days' looks like any span of time but names the month.
explanation.definitionFit: April is a month with thirty days, as the rhyme 'Thirty days hath September, April, June and November' says.

clue.text: National firm once caught importing large antelope

indicators.note: importing means taking a piece inside

parts.note: ICI, Imperial Chemical Industries, was a British firm, now gone
the eland is a large African antelope
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A former company caught bringing in a big antelope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'importing' puts the antelope inside after the first two letters. 'National' is a noun here: a citizen of a country.
explanation.definitionFit: Icelandic as an adjective describes the nation of Iceland; the definition reads as relating to a nation.

clue.text: Thickhead finally sacked by boss

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word sacked

parts.note: an umbo is the boss at the centre of a shield

explanation.surface: A dim worker is finally fired by the boss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boss' is the stud on a shield, not a manager.
explanation.definitionFit: Dumbo is an informal insult for a stupid person, like thickhead.

clue.text: Wonderful person unexpectedly met abroad

indicators.note: unexpectedly signals the letters of met abroad come out in a surprising new order

explanation.surface: Meeting a wonderful person by chance while travelling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unexpectedly' rearranges METABROAD.
explanation.definitionFit: A dreamboat is an informal term for a very attractive or ideal person.

clue.text: Dance composed by business graduate after game

indicators.note: after places the graduate piece following the game

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a game
an MBA is a Master of Business Administration

explanation.surface: A dance written by an MBA holder after a match.
explanation.definitionFit: The rumba is a Cuban ballroom dance.

clue.text: Father seen around at send-up

indicators.note: around means the word for father is placed round the next piece

parts.note: to sire is to father; a sire is a father

explanation.surface: Dad is seen hanging around at a parody show.
explanation.definitionFit: Satire mocks its target, which is what a send-up does.

clue.text: Waller starts to take on cattle, keeping animals for slaughter

parts.note: Fats Waller was a jazz pianist

indicators.note: starts to picks the opening letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: Fats Waller starts taking on cattle, keeping beasts to be slaughtered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starts to' gives TOCK from take, on, cattle, keeping.
explanation.definitionFit: Fatstock is livestock fattened for market and killing.
